summary: LLM.generate with logprobs=2, prompt_logprobs=1 returns logprobs null, cumulative_logprob null and no prompt_logprobs: sampler/gpu-model-runner.sample-tokens compute top-k scores but drop them from ModelRunnerOutput, and scheduler-kv update_from_output never sets new_logprobs/new_prompt_logprobs_tensors, so logprobs-processor.update-sample-logprobs is never called (sampler.py:171-218, model_runner.py:2150-2176, scheduler.py:2156-2270). Also needs scheduler-kv and engine-core fixes.

gpu-model-runner.execute-model calls flash-attention-metadata-builder.build directly without positions, also for hybrid models; MambaHybridModelState.prepare_attn, which passes positions=input_batch.positions to build_attn_metadata (mamba_hybrid.py:339), is not modeled.

sampler.apply-sampling-params ignores the bad-words mask when choosing the stand-in token: bad-words-state.apply reports the greedy token T masked, yet the banned run emits T again (code sets -inf, bad_words.py:165). Secondary: SamplingParams.update_from_tokenizer is not modeled, so text bad_words are dropped (engine-core).
